messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: NexusMed dedicated pool (nexusmed-prod-vpc) - canary traffic started. Observed error rate spike >8% over 1m and latency increase. Root ts: 1801122334.

sara: Acknowledged. I'm on it — pulling logs and checking the artifact. Is this the pinned rollout @miguel pushed?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout triggered by @miguel at 2026-11-09T10:02Z. Artifact id: artifact-2026-11-09-7f3b. Traffic split: 5% canary -> 95% baseline. Health checks failing.

kai: Seeing 500s from model-worker on nexusmed-pool-02. Sample logs: 
```
2026-11-09T10:06:11Z nexusmed-pool-02 model-worker ERROR inference::kv_cache: failed to map sharded KV
HTTP/1.1 500 "internal_error"
```

miguel: That artifact includes new quant kernels we added. Looks like a binary/kernel mismatch with the model runtime on that node. I'm seeing similar locally when running the new kernel bundle. Suggest pin back to last-known-good artifact artifact-2026-10-28-4a1c.

sara: Can we hot-rollback to the pinned artifact? How long to complete? Confirm NexusMed has dedicated pool only affected?

kai: Yes — dedicated pool = tenant isolated, no cross-customer impact. We can run: 
```
rctl set-artifact --pool nexusmed-prod --artifact artifact-2026-10-28-4a1c --force
```
That triggers rolling restart across pool nodes, estimated 6-8m to healthy.

anna: I'll take the rollback coordination and watch the health checks. @deploy-bot please initiate pin to artifact-2026-10-28-4a1c and keep canary at 5% until green.

deploy-bot: Rollback command issued by @anna at 2026-11-09T10:12Z. Pinning artifact artifact-2026-10-28-4a1c to nexusmed-prod pool. Estimated completion: 8m. 

sara: Notifying CS + NexusMed POC — @lee-cs and @amanda-nexus. Impact description: transient 500s for a subset of canary requests while we rollback. No data plane leakage, tenant isolated.

lee-cs: Thanks — I'll open a customer ticket and message the NexusMed on-call. I'll say expected transient errors ~10m and we're rolling back.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed at 2026-11-09T10:21Z. NexusMed pool artifact now artifact-2026-10-28-4a1c. Health: error rate <0.1% (1m), latency back to baseline.

sara: Verified health. Marking incident mitigated for now. Leaving notes for postmortem and scheduling follow-up actions. Handoff to @vince for post-incident.

vince: Taking on post-incident. I'll schedule a blameless postmortem, confirm kernel compatibility tests are added to preflight, and verify rollback automation. Ping me with logs or outstanding items.

miguel: I'll add a GPU/kernel compatibility preflight to rollout pipeline and add an automated rollback rule: if 5xx > 3% within 5m for canary, auto-pin back and alert.

sara: Sweet. Thanks everyone — closing active mitigation. :white_check_mark:
